title: office.search request
description: Full-text search over indexed sources, knowledge pages and artifacts. Every filter narrows the results before the limit.

query.description: Search terms; each must match (as a prefix) in the title, summary, body or tags. An empty or blank query is refused with invalid_argument.

kind.description: Only documents of this Library layer.

template.description: Only knowledge pages whose frontmatter names this template (for example person).

tag.description: Only documents carrying this tag exactly (for example client:acme).

since.description: Only documents dated on or after this day. A document's date is its occurred_at, else captured_at, else updated_at, else last_verified, else the date in a dated id (src-YYYYMMDD-…, art-YYYYMMDD-…); undated documents are excluded.

until.description: Only documents dated on or before this day (see since). Must not be before since.
